assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Sort control changes row order but never updates aria-sort
description: Activating the Date sort button reorders the rows in both variants. The alpha header keeps aria-sort=none, so assistive technology reports an unsorted column while the visible order has changed.

relatedElements.note: The control updates aria-sort to ascending then descending.

expectedBehaviour: A sortable column reports its current sort direction.
actualBehaviour: aria-sort remains none after each sort.
userImpact: Screen-reader users cannot tell how the table is ordered, and may misread the changed row order.

detection.note: Only observable after the interaction; the default state is correct.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Sort the sightings table and listen for the column's sort state.

assertions: aria-sort is still none after two sorts.
tests: tests/subtle-widgets.spec.js: keeps the alpha sort state stale

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
